hypothesis_text: 15m candles exhibiting minimal wick rejection (marubozu_side with wicks <= 5% of total candle range) reflect aggressive directional liquidity sweeps that lead to persistent momentum continuation over 30m to 4h horizons across liquid altcoins, particularly when confirmed by volume expansion and orderbook depth imbalance.
narrative: During aggressive market impulses, takers sweep resting limit orders across the book resulting in a bar that opens near one extreme and closes near the opposite extreme with virtually no shadow rejection. This signifies overwhelming directional dominance and forced inventory adjustments among market makers, causing forward momentum to persist across the 30m to 4h horizon as liquidity reconstitutes.
